evidence: Labeled Utils/log/libs; refactors libsecp256k1 ECC context management across src/crypto/ and src/common/ to enable hardware SHA256 acceleration.
rationale: Hardware SHA256 acceleration provides substantial speedups to signing operations in libsecp256k1. Author benchmarks report 'signing latency reductions of 13% for ECDSASign (79.2 µs down to 69.3 µs) and 7% for SchnorrSign (39.9 µs down to 37.1 µs)' on ARM64 hardware, delivering durable performance gains to node and wallet crypto primitives.
